meaning_zh: 灾害的，灾难性的（派生：disaster n. 灾难，不幸）
sentence_en: The typhoon had a disastrous effect on the local economy because it destroyed all the coconut trees.
sentence_zh: 台风摧毁了所有椰子树，给当地经济带来了灾难性影响。

meaning_zh: 大灾难（程度较 disaster 严重）
sentence_en: Action is urgently required to prevent the disaster from turning into a catastrophe.
sentence_zh: 必须紧急采取行动，防止这场灾害演变成大灾难。

meaning_zh: 污染，弄脏；玷污（派生：contamination n. 污染）
sentence_en: All kitchen staff must wash their hands carefully to remove any germs that may contaminate the food.
sentence_zh: 所有厨房员工都必须仔细洗手，去除可能污染食物的细菌。

sentence_en: Drinking coffee causes us to feel more alert by creating a chemical reaction in the brain.
sentence_zh: 喝咖啡会在大脑中引发化学反应，让我们感觉更清醒。

sentence_en: The earth's climate is getting hotter and drier due to global warming.
sentence_zh: 由于全球变暖，地球的气候变得越来越热、越来越干。

sentence_en: After the project is finished, a crane will be used to dispose of all the waste materials.
sentence_zh: 项目完成后，将用起重机清理掉所有废料。

meaning_zh: 侵蚀，腐蚀（派生：erode v. 侵蚀）
sentence_en: Due to the threat of erosion, it is unsafe to build on the land.
sentence_zh: 由于有侵蚀的威胁，在这块地上建房不安全。

sentence_en: Deforestation is one of the consequences of our expanding urban areas.
sentence_zh: 滥伐森林是城市不断扩张的后果之一。

sentence_en: The government is considering placing a tax on the carbon emissions of each company.
sentence_zh: 政府正在考虑对每家公司的碳排放征税。

meaning_zh: 温室（搭配：greenhouse effect 温室效应；greenhouse gas 温室气体）
sentence_en: Tomatoes that are grown in greenhouses are able to survive through the winter months.
sentence_zh: 种在温室里的西红柿能熬过冬季。

sentence_en: Most of the carbon emissions are caused by burning fossil fuels such as coal and oil.
sentence_zh: 大部分碳排放来自燃烧煤、石油等化石燃料。

sentence_en: The blaze from the bushfire was so hot and intense it burnt everything that stood in its path.
sentence_zh: 丛林大火又热又猛，烧毁了沿途的一切。

sentence_en: The spark from the engine caused a conflagration that destroyed almost half of the forest.
sentence_zh: 发动机溅出的火花引发了一场大火，烧毁了将近一半的森林。

sentence_en: It is imperative that we reduce consumption of fossil fuels if we are to halt or reverse global warming.
sentence_zh: 要想阻止或扭转全球变暖，我们必须减少化石燃料的消耗。

sentence_en: The wildlife of Australia is rich and diverse.
sentence_zh: 澳大利亚的野生动物丰富多样。

sentence_en: It is dangerous to live near an active volcano because at any time, without advance notice, it can erupt.
sentence_zh: 住在活火山附近很危险，因为它随时可能毫无预兆地喷发。

sentence_en: It was an iceberg which led to the demise of the Titanic.
sentence_zh: 正是一座冰山导致了泰坦尼克号的沉没。

sentence_en: The waterfall was very picturesque until the government decided to build a big dam a little way upstream.
sentence_zh: 这道瀑布曾经风景如画，直到政府决定在上游不远处修建一座大坝。

sentence_en: Typhoons north of the equator rotate counterclockwise, while south of the equator they are known as cyclones and spin clockwise.
sentence_zh: 赤道以北的台风逆时针旋转，而在赤道以南它们被称为气旋，顺时针旋转。

sentence_en: The introduction of civilisation into natural ecosystems often has devastating effects.
sentence_zh: 人类文明进入自然生态系统，往往会带来毁灭性的影响。

sentence_en: You cannot understand the ecology of an area by looking at individual plants and animals.
sentence_zh: 只看个别动植物，是无法了解一个地区的生态的。

meaning_zh: 使…毁灭，严重破坏；令人沮丧、震惊
sentence_en: The village devastated by floods last year celebrated its recovery with a parade.
sentence_zh: 去年被洪水摧毁的村庄举行游行，庆祝重建完成。

sentence_en: Bushfires cause mass devastation to forests and wildlife every year.
sentence_zh: 丛林大火每年都给森林和野生动物造成大规模破坏。

sentence_en: The vegetation in tropical forests is very dense. So much so that in many places you cannot see the sky.
sentence_zh: 热带森林的植被非常茂密，以至于很多地方都看不到天空。

sentence_en: That humanitarian group's goal is the eradication of poverty in all of Africa.
sentence_zh: 那个人道主义组织的目标是消除整个非洲的贫困。

sentence_en: The effects of pollution are eliminating species around the world.
sentence_zh: 污染的影响正在使世界各地的物种消失。

sentence_en: The cleanliness of the school cafeteria was so horrible that it didn't pass inspections.
sentence_zh: 学校食堂的卫生糟糕透了，没能通过检查。

sentence_en: Not all bacteria is bad for you; in fact, the human body needs bacteria for some bodily functions.
sentence_zh: 并非所有细菌都有害；事实上，人体的某些功能需要细菌。

sentence_en: During the typhoon, the rainfall exceeded the amount the city would usually get in one month.
sentence_zh: 台风期间的降雨量超过了这座城市平时一个月的降雨量。

sentence_en: The effects of the earthquake were profound. The entire city was damaged in one way or another.
sentence_zh: 地震的影响极其深远，整座城市都受到了不同程度的破坏。

meaning_zh: 牵连；指示，暗示（派生：implicate v. 涉及，牵连）
sentence_en: You need to consider the implications of this decision to buy property in the marsh.
sentence_zh: 你需要考虑在沼泽地买房这一决定可能带来的影响。

sentence_en: In the mornings I like to eat breakfast on the terrace while listening to the birds singing.
sentence_zh: 早上我喜欢在露台上吃早餐，听鸟儿歌唱。

meaning_zh: 测量员，勘测员（派生：survey n./v. 测量，勘测）
sentence_en: The surveyor determined the natural boundaries of the property by using a prism system and GPS.
sentence_zh: 测量员用棱镜系统和 GPS 确定了这块地产的自然边界。

sentence_en: The Channel Tunnel connects England to France.
sentence_zh: 英吉利海峡隧道连接着英国和法国。

sentence_en: Because silicon, as a material, is used a lot in computers, the word 'silicon' has become another word for the computer industry itself.
sentence_zh: 由于硅这种材料在计算机中大量使用，“硅”这个词已成为计算机行业本身的代称。

meaning_zh: 探测，勘察（派生：explore v. 探索，考察）
sentence_en: A few months ago the legislature signed a law to increase funding for space exploration. They hope to send a man to Mars someday!
sentence_zh: 几个月前，立法机构签署了一项增加太空探索经费的法案。他们希望有一天能把人送上火星！

sentence_en: Neil Armstrong was the first astronaut to set foot on the moon.
sentence_zh: 尼尔·阿姆斯特朗是第一位踏上月球的航天员。

sentence_en: She finds astronomy very amazing, so one thing her boyfriend did to impress her was to have a star named after her.
sentence_zh: 她觉得天文学非常奇妙，所以她男朋友为了打动她，用她的名字命名了一颗星星。

meaning_zh: 侵略的，入侵的（派生：invasion n. 侵略）
sentence_en: The invasive 'crown of thorns' starfish is seen as a major threat to the Great Barrier Reef.
sentence_zh: 入侵物种棘冠海星被视为大堡礁的主要威胁。

meaning_zh: 保存；维护（同：conservation 对自然环境的维护）
sentence_en: Historical preservation tends to be popular in very rich areas, but I think that there are sites in many poor areas that are also worth preserving.
sentence_zh: 历史遗迹保护往往在富裕地区更受重视，但我认为许多贫困地区也有值得保护的遗址。

sentence_en: The river that goes through our town is in danger of flooding. If such an event were to happen, it would ruin several shops and houses.
sentence_zh: 流经我们镇的那条河有泛滥的危险。如果真的发生，会毁掉好几家商店和房屋。
